description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CVS Health is a healthcare company focused on creating a more connected, convenient, and compassionate health experience. The Associate Software Development Engineer will support production operations, develop reliable digital solutions, implement automation, and help maintain security, compliance, and operational excellence. The role also involves testing, documentation, incident management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Software engineer building digital solutions, testing code, documenting systems, and resolving production incidents

Responsibilities:
• Leverages programming skills to design and implement efficient and reliable digital solutions
• Writes code, develops software components, and implements functionalities according to project requirements
• Contributes to technical discussions, proposes design patterns, and makes architectural decisions to ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability
• Tests own code and participates in the overall quality assurance process
• Writes and executes unit tests, conducts code reviews, debugs, and troubleshoots issues to ensure the reliability and stability of digital solutions
• Creates and maintains technical documentation, including system designs, specifications, user guides, and other relevant documentation
• Seeks opportunities for professional development and growth, such as attending conferences, taking online courses, or participating in relevant training programs
• Manage incident processes to quickly resolve production issues and reduce business impact
• Partner with cross-functional teams to identify root causes and improve efficiencies within system

Requirements:
• Must have successfully completed corporate internship program
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science or related field

Preferred:
• Experience with Python
• Experience with Postgres SQL and GCP environment

Skills:
• Must have successfully completed corporate internship program
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science or related field
• Experience with Python
• Experience with Postgres SQL and GCP environment

Pay: $29.72/hr - $59.42/hr
